test_title: PYST 2: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Rs. 9000 is lent at the rate of 80 percent per annum on compound interest (compounded half yearly). What will be the compound interest of 12 months?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 9000

Rate of interest (R) = 80% per annum compounded half yearly

Time (T) = 12 months = 1 year

**Concept:**

For compound interest compounded half-yearly, the rate is halved, and the time period is doubled.

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = P × (1 + R/2×100)²×T - P

**Calculation:**

Rate per half year = 80/2 = 40% = 0.40

Number of half years in 1 year = 2

⇒ CI = 9000 × (1 + 0.40)² - 9000

⇒ CI = 9000 × (1.40)² - 9000

⇒ CI = 9000 × 1.96 - 9000

⇒ CI = 17640 - 9000

⇒ CI = 8640

**∴ The compound interest for 12 months is Rs. 8640.**
